CropGuard AI — 03 ResNet50 + CBAM CNN¶

NASTP Institute of Information Technology | AI335L — Deep Learning Lab | Spring 2026

Phase 3 replaces the MLP baseline with a deep CNN architecture: ResNet50 + CBAM Attention trained via two-phase transfer learning.

Phase 3 Achievements¶

Metric MLP Baseline Phase 3 Target Phase 3 Result
Test Accuracy 63.88% ≥92.0% 92.1 ± 0.3% ✓
Macro F1 0.555 ≥0.880 0.882 ± 0.003 ✓
ROC-AUC 0.940 ≥0.970 0.973 ± 0.002 ✓
Potato Healthy F1 0.000 ≥0.700 ~0.500 ✗

Tasks Covered¶

  1. Architecture justification and CBAM implementation
  2. Two-phase transfer learning (feature extraction → fine-tuning)
  3. Regularization ablation (3 configurations)
  4. Multi-seed comparison with MLP baseline
  5. Grad-CAM visualization
  6. Severity assessment and treatment recommendation
  7. MobileNetV2 vs ResNet50 speed/accuracy tradeoff

1. Architecture Justification¶

In [2]:
print('=== Architecture: ResNet50 + CBAM ===')
print()
print('WHY CNN over MLP:')
print('  MLPs treat each pixel independently — no spatial awareness.')
print('  CNNs exploit translation invariance: disease lesion in corner == center.')
print('  This spatial inductive bias explains the 63% → 92% accuracy jump.')
print()
print('WHY ResNet50:')
print('  50-layer residual network. Residual connections solve vanishing gradients.')
print('  ImageNet-1K pretrained: 23.5M params of hierarchical visual features.')
print('  Top-5 ImageNet error: 3.57% (He et al., CVPR 2016).')
print()
print('WHY CBAM:')
print('  Channel attention: which feature channels matter for disease detection?')
print('  Spatial attention: WHERE in the leaf is the disease?')
print('  Critical for Grad-CAM to produce interpretable localization maps.')
print()
print('Transfer Learning Strategy:')
print('  Phase 1 (10 epochs): Freeze all ResNet50 layers. Train CBAM + head only.')
print('  Phase 2 (20 epochs): Unfreeze top 30 layers. Fine-tune at lower LR.')

=== Architecture: ResNet50 + CBAM ===

WHY CNN over MLP:
  MLPs treat each pixel independently — no spatial awareness.
  CNNs exploit translation invariance: disease lesion in corner == center.
  This spatial inductive bias explains the 63% → 92% accuracy jump.

WHY ResNet50:
  50-layer residual network. Residual connections solve vanishing gradients.
  ImageNet-1K pretrained: 23.5M params of hierarchical visual features.
  Top-5 ImageNet error: 3.57% (He et al., CVPR 2016).

WHY CBAM:
  Channel attention: which feature channels matter for disease detection?
  Spatial attention: WHERE in the leaf is the disease?
  Critical for Grad-CAM to produce interpretable localization maps.

Transfer Learning Strategy:
  Phase 1 (10 epochs): Freeze all ResNet50 layers. Train CBAM + head only.
  Phase 2 (20 epochs): Unfreeze top 30 layers. Fine-tune at lower LR.

3. Regularization Ablation (3 Configurations)¶

In [5]:
from src.utils import get_val_test_transform, PlantVillageDataset
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

ablation_configs = {
    'Config1_Unregularized': {'dropout': 0.0, 'label_smoothing': 0.0, 'weight_decay': 0.0},
    'Config2_Regularized':   {'dropout': 0.4, 'label_smoothing': 0.1, 'weight_decay': 1e-4},
    'Config3_Full_BN':       {'dropout': 0.4, 'label_smoothing': 0.1, 'weight_decay': 1e-4},
}

ablation_results = {}
criterion_abl = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

for cfg_name, abl_cfg in ablation_configs.items():
    print(f'\nRunning {cfg_name}...')
    set_seed(42)
    abl_model = CropGuardCNN(
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        dropout=abl_cfg['dropout'],
        use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=True, head_dims=[512, 256]
    ).to(DEVICE)

    cfg = TrainConfig(
        phase1_epochs=5, phase2_epochs=5,
        weight_decay=abl_cfg['weight_decay'],
        label_smoothing=abl_cfg['label_smoothing'],
        output_dir=str(CKPT_DIR),
    )
    history = train_model(abl_model, train_loader, val_loader,
                          cfg=cfg, run_name=cfg_name, device=DEVICE)

    _, test_acc, preds, labels, probs = evaluate(abl_model, test_loader, criterion_abl, DEVICE)
    f1  = f1_score(labels, preds, average='macro', zero_division=0)
    auc = roc_auc_score(labels, probs, multi_class='ovr', average='macro')

    ablation_results[cfg_name] = {
        'test_acc': test_acc, 'macro_f1': f1, 'roc_auc': auc,
        'train_acc': history['train_acc'], 'val_acc': history['val_acc'],
        'train_loss': history['train_loss'], 'val_loss': history['val_loss'],
    }
    print(f'  Acc={test_acc:.4f} F1={f1:.4f} AUC={auc:.4f}')

4. Multi-Seed Comparison with MLP Baseline¶

In [7]:
criterion_eval = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
seed_results = []

for seed in SEEDS:
    print(f'\n--- Seed {seed} ---')
    set_seed(seed)
    m = CropGuardCNN(
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.4,
        use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=True, head_dims=[512, 256]
    ).to(DEVICE)

    cfg_seed = TrainConfig(
        phase1_epochs=5, phase2_epochs=10, seed=seed,
        output_dir=str(CKPT_DIR),
    )
    train_model(m, train_loader, val_loader, cfg=cfg_seed,
                run_name=f'resnet50_seed{seed}', device=DEVICE)

    _, acc, preds, labels, probs = evaluate(m, test_loader, criterion_eval, DEVICE)
    f1  = f1_score(labels, preds, average='macro', zero_division=0)
    try:
        auc_val = roc_auc_score(labels, probs, multi_class='ovr', average='macro')
    except:
        auc_val = float('nan')

    seed_results.append({'seed': seed, 'acc': acc, 'f1': f1, 'auc': auc_val})
    print(f'  Acc={acc:.4f} F1={f1:.4f} AUC={auc_val:.4f}')

accs = [r['acc'] for r in seed_results]
f1s  = [r['f1']  for r in seed_results]
aucs = [r['auc'] for r in seed_results]

print(f'\n=== Multi-seed Results ===')
print(f'Accuracy : {np.mean(accs):.4f} ± {np.std(accs):.4f}')
print(f'Macro F1 : {np.mean(f1s):.4f} ± {np.std(f1s):.4f}')
print(f'ROC-AUC  : {np.mean(aucs):.4f} ± {np.std(aucs):.4f}')

from src.gradcam import GradCAMWrapper, get_one_image_per_class

cam_wrapper = GradCAMWrapper(best_model, DEVICE)
class_images = get_one_image_per_class(test_loader, NUM_CLASSES)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, NUM_CLASSES, figsize=(NUM_CLASSES * 3, 9))
fig.suptitle('CropGuard AI — Grad-CAM Disease Localization (ResNet50+CBAM)',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

for cls_idx, disp in enumerate(CLASS_DISPLAY):
    if cls_idx not in class_images:
        for row in range(3):
            axes[row][cls_idx].axis('off')
        continue
    img_t = class_images[cls_idx]
    overlay, heatmap = cam_wrapper.explain(img_t, target_class=cls_idx)
    img_rgb = denormalize(img_t)

    axes[0][cls_idx].imshow(img_rgb)
    axes[0][cls_idx].set_title(disp, fontsize=7, fontweight='bold')
    axes[0][cls_idx].axis('off')
    axes[1][cls_idx].imshow(heatmap, cmap='jet')
    axes[1][cls_idx].axis('off')
    axes[2][cls_idx].imshow(overlay)
    axes[2][cls_idx].axis('off')

axes[0][0].set_ylabel('Original', fontsize=9)
axes[1][0].set_ylabel('Grad-CAM', fontsize=9)

7. MobileNetV2 vs ResNet50 Speed/Accuracy¶

In [11]:
set_seed(42)
mobile_model = CropGuardMobileNet(
    num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.3, freeze_backbone=True
).to(DEVICE)

# Quick training
mobile_cfg = TrainConfig(
    phase1_epochs=8, phase2_epochs=15, output_dir=str(CKPT_DIR)
)
train_model(mobile_model, train_loader, val_loader,
            cfg=mobile_cfg, run_name='mobilenet_v2', device=DEVICE)

_, mobile_acc, mobile_preds, mobile_labels, _ = evaluate(
    mobile_model, test_loader, criterion_eval, DEVICE)
mobile_f1 = f1_score(mobile_labels, mobile_preds, average='macro', zero_division=0)

# Latency benchmark
dummy_input = torch.randn(1, 3, 224, 224).to(DEVICE)

def measure_latency(m, inp, n=100):
    m.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for _ in range(10): m(inp)  # warmup
        if DEVICE.type == 'cuda': torch.cuda.synchronize()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        for _ in range(n): m(inp)
        if DEVICE.type == 'cuda': torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return (time.perf_counter() - t0) / n * 1000

resnet_ms = measure_latency(best_model, dummy_input)
mobile_ms = measure_latency(mobile_model, dummy_input)

print('\n=== Speed / Accuracy Tradeoff ===')
print(f'{"Model":<30} {"Acc":>8} {"F1":>8} {"Params":>10} {"Latency":>10}')
print('-' * 70)
print(f'{"ResNet50+CBAM":<30} {test_acc:>8.4f} {macro_f1:>8.4f} {"~25.3M":>10} {resnet_ms:>8.1f}ms')
